newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers recover from slip, buyers edge back.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers recover from slip, buyers edge back.

text.p: ARA bunkers recovered from a morning slide, returning to Monday's closing level, while prices in most European ports fell sharply and some buyers returned to the market, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST returned to $96/$97 fob after barges recovered from a $3 slide in the morning. Traders said many of those that needed to sell by the end of the month had done so. Increased bunker volumes also helped to lift prices.
Total demand in the ARA area topped 15,000 tonnes.
"We all thought people had too much. Now it's over and all of a sudden there are many enquiries," one supplier said.
Hamburg slid down by $4 a tonne in response to Rotterdam's sharp fall on Monday.
Mediterranean bunkers also fell sharply, with the exception of those in Italy. Gains of aroun $1 a tonne left Italian sellers with almost no enquiries.
In France and Spain, prices were down by around $5 and demand was healthy.
In Fujairah, sellers clung to their offers of around $98 fob, but attracted very few buyers.
